title: ASTRA COLONY Social Communication Protocol v1

semantics.ASK: Ask nearby peers for missing knowledge.
semantics.REPORT: Transmit factual claims which may later be verified or disproved.
semantics.OFFER: Offer useful information or role-based assistance.
semantics.WARN: Broadcast a high-urgency environmental or safety warning.

trustRule: Relayed claims are weighted by receiver trust and speaker credibility. Direct observation can verify or disprove claims, changing receiver trust and speaker reputation.
